title: Oracle3: Agent Tools and Execution Infrastructure for Prediction Markets
description: Oracle3 provides agent tools and execution infrastructure for prediction markets: public market data, fee-aware checks conditional on supplied relationships, and a local paper ledger through MCP, plus a separate Python trading engine. Development work includes explicit execution states and reproducible failure traces. The software builds on U Lab and Coinjure; see NOTICE for upstream attribution and licensing. Software regression results do not establish LLM effectiveness or live profitability.
